description.value:
You create a wave of water that you ride, banking around obstacles and surfing to higher ground. You move up to 35 feet, raising yourself up to 5 feet above the ground.

(You can avoid many types of 3 in this way.) You must end your movement on an unoccupied space where you have solid footing. This movement isn't a Stride, but you measure the distance in a similar way, and it still triggers reactions caused by movement. You can't transport anyone else with you.

higher_level_description.value: Heightened (+2): Increase the distance you move by 5 feet and the maximum height traveled above the ground by 5 feet.
